correct_query: SELECT doc.specialty, strftime('%m', a.admit_date) AS admit_month, AVG(t.cost) AS avg_treatment_cost, MAX(t.cost) AS max_treatment_cost FROM Doctors doc JOIN Treatments t ON doc.doc_id = t.doc_id JOIN Admissions a ON t.admit_id = a.admit_id JOIN Patients p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND a.admit_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY doc.specialty, admit_month HAVING COUNT(t.treat_id) > 20 ORDER BY doc.specialty ASC, max_treatment_cost DESC;
